chunks: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
Indeed, the deeds of the children are based on those of their fathers; whoever finds goodness in his father's record, he will emerge with it, and whoever finds evil, he will emerge with it.
And Allah, the Exalted, is the Knower.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of parents' deeds on their children in Shia theology?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq utilizes this principle to elucidate the transmission of spiritual merit or burden across generations, a key concept in Shia jurisprudence regarding the continuity of righteous legacy. This establishes that while individual accountability remains, the foundational spiritual environment set by the father significantly influences the child's standing, reflecting the communal nature of salvation in Shia thought.
